1453-4694-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-7306-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

539-855-1491-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-3899-6972--112.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
1483-3899-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1496-4050-7498-7541.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 5 life.
Grave Researcher is prepared.
1496-4050-7498-7541.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Biblioplex Tomekeeper, adding {B}.
Cast the copy of Reanimate from exile by paying {B}, returning Biblioplex Tomekeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield and losing 4 life.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve Biblioplex Tromekeeper's trigger, preparing Grave Researcher.
Resolve Verdant Sun's Avatar's trigger, gaining 4 life.
Repeat.

5776-5777-6692.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5776-5777-6692.description:
Activate Wicked Wolf by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Wicked Wolf ability
Repeat.

751-1741-2510-5778.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
751-1741-2510-5778.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries with offspring by paying {1}{U} using the cost reduction from Semblance Anvil.
When Cloud of Faeries enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries abilities, untapping two lands.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When the token copy of Cloud of Faeries enters, its ability triggers, untapping two lands.
Activate four lands by tapping them, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake with offspring by paying {U}, using cost reduction from Semblance Anvil.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its own ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries to its owner's hand.
Resolve the offspring ability, creating a token copy of Shrieking Drake.
When the token copy of Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers, returning the nontoken Shrieking Drake to its owner's hand.
Repeat.
751-1741-2510-5778.notes: Once infinite mana has been generated, the Shrieking Drake can return any creature other than Zinnia to hand to recast infinitely.

1778-3661-6516-7735.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3661-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1251-1409-3099-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

670-1619-4142-6141.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6141.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Displacer Beast until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Displacer Beast to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Displacer Beast enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Beast trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Displacer Beast until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

2292-4535--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

1636-5371-7014-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
1636-5371-7014-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

4050-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-5687-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
4050-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Phyrexian Altar.

57-2341-4460-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon isn't your commander.
57-2341-4460-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
2921-6972-7233.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4487-4616-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Phyrexian Marauder from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

618-2438-4344.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1085-3967-4053.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

2511-3781-4191--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-3436-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Worn Powerstone's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1491-2464-6218-6260.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2464-6218-6260.notablePrerequisites:
If Song of Freyalise is on the battlefield, it has exactly one lore counter on it.
Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2464-6218-6260.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1140-1636-3143-4500.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-4500.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

5033-5078-5679-5741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
5033-5078-5679-5741.description:
Activate a land that enters the battlefield untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kellan triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2178-5010-5256-5615.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to The Master.
The Master does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5010-5256-5615.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, its first ability and The Master trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Master trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting Golgari Thug from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1189-1744-2560-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Chandra's Ignition targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Chandra's Ignition, causing the Golem to deal damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Chandra's Ignition.

725-2466-5251.notablePrerequisites: Aura of Dominion attached to Emmara.
725-2466-5251.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the Soldier, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

92-3392-3859.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 1 life.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

2493-2596-3542-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
2493-2596-3542-4050.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Palinchron, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Palinchron enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.
